message.content:
Based on the screenshot, this is a **full product detail page** (not a modal or dialog). It's a comprehensive e-commerce product view for "AirSound Pro Max Wireless Headphones" on a site called "Z Shop."

## Overall Layout Structure
The page uses a **three-column layout** on a light gray/off-white background (`#f5f5f5` or similar):
- **Left column**: Product image gallery (approximately 30% width)
- **Center column**: Main product information and purchase options (approximately 45% width)
- **Right column**: Specifications sidebar and support widget (approximately 25% width)

---

## Header Section
**Top Bar** (Dark charcoal/black background):
- Left: "Free shipping on orders over $99" with package icon
- Center: "Secure payment" with lock icon + "Use code WELCOME15 for 15% off"
- Right: "Ship to: US"

**Main Navigation** (Vibrant orange/yellow gradient background `#FFA500` to `#FFD700`):
- Logo: "Z Shop" with tagline "Shop smarter. live better"
- Location selector: "Deliver to United States"
- Currency: "$ USD"
- Search bar: White input field with magnifying glass icon
- User account: "Hello, Sign in Account"
- Icons: Theme toggle, orders, wishlist (heart), cart

**Category Navigation** (Orange bar):
Categories include: Today's Deals (with -22% badge), All, Audio, Beauty, Books, Computers, Electronics, Fashion, Grocery, Home & Kitchen, Sports & Outdoors, Toys & Games

---

## Main Content Area

### Left Column: Product Images
- **Primary image**: Large product photo of black over-ear headphones against bright yellow/gold background
- **Badges on image**: 
  - Pink/magenta "-22%" discount badge (top left)
  - Orange "Featured" badge (top right)
- **Thumbnail gallery** (below main image): 
  - Two small square thumbnails showing different angles
  - First thumbnail has yellow border indicating it's active/selected
  - Second shows side profile view

### Center Column: Product Information

**Product Title**: 
"AirSound Pro Max Wireless Headphones" (Large bold text, ~28-32px)

**Rating Section**:
- 4.7-star rating (yellow/gold stars)
- "8231 ratings" link in blue
- Tags: #headphones #anc #wireless (light gray pill badges)

**Pricing**:
- Current price: **$349** (Large bold black text, ~36px)
- Original price: ~~$449~~ (strikethrough gray)
- Discount badge: "-22%" (pink/red background, white text)
- Savings: "You save $100" (red/pink text)
- Note: "Inclusive of all taxes" (small gray text)

**Product Description**:
"Active noise cancellation, 40-hour battery, spatial audio, lossless audio via USB-C. Studio-grade sound." (Medium gray text, line-height ~1.5)

**Color Selection**:
- Label: "Color: Select" (bold)
- Four color options in rounded rectangular buttons:
  - **Space Gray** (dark gray circle) - appears selected with dark border
  - **Silver** (light gray circle)
  - **Midnight** (black circle) with "+$10" upcharge indicator
  - **Rose Gold** (rose/pink circle) with "+$15" upcharge indicator

**Stock Status**:
- "In stock" (green text)

**Quantity Selector**:
- Minus button (-) | Input field showing "1" | Plus button (+)
- Light gray border, rounded corners
- Adjacent text: "Subtotal: **$349**" (bold)

**Action Buttons** (Full width, ~48px height):
1. **"Select options"** - Light peach/orange background (`#FFCCBC` or similar), darker orange text, shopping cart icon
2. **"Buy now"** - Coral/salmon background (`#FF8A80` or `#FFAB91`), white text, prominent CTA

**Secondary Actions** (Row of outline buttons):
- "Add to wishlist" (heart icon)
- "Compare" (arrows icon)
- "Share" (share node icon)
- All have light gray borders, white backgrounds

**Price Alert Button**:
- Bell icon + "Price alert" (outline style)

**Delivery Banner** (Light cream/yellow background `#FFF8E1`, rounded corners):
- Truck icon + "**Free express delivery**" (bold red/brown text)
- "Order in the next **4 hours** to get it by tomorrow." (4 hours in bold orange/red)

**Trust Badges** (Below images, in left column area):
- Free delivery over $99 (truck icon)
- 30-day returns (refresh icon)
- 2-year warranty (shield icon)
- In stock ships today (box icon)
- All with orange icons and dark text

### Right Column: Sidebar

**Specifications Card** (White background, rounded corners, shadow):
- Header: "**Specifications**" (bold, with border-bottom)
- Table layout with light gray dividers:
  - Driver: 40mm
  - Battery: 40h
  - ANC: Adaptive Hybrid
  - Codecs: LDAC, AAC
- Labels in gray, values in black, right-aligned values

**Help Widget** (Light purple/lavender background `#F3E5F5`, rounded corners):
- Header: "**Need help deciding?**" (purple text)
- Body: "Our 24/7 shopping concierge can help you choose." (purple text)
- Button: "**Chat with expert**" (white background, purple border, purple text, full width)

---

## Bottom Section: Bundle Area

**Section Header**:
- Purple "Bundle" badge (pill shape)
- Text: "**Frequently bought together**" (bold, large)

**Bundle Products Row** (Horizontal scroll/flex):
- Three product cards with green checkmarks (top-right corner indicating selection):
  1. Main headphones (yellow bg, same as product)
  2. Headphone case/stand (dark red/magenta gradient background)
  3. Portable speaker (gray/black with orange accent)
- Plus signs (+) between items indicating bundle composition

**Bundle Pricing Summary** (Right side or below):
- Label: "BUNDLE TOTAL"
- Price: **$678.98** (large bold)
- Original: ~~$828.98~~ (strikethrough)
- Savings: "Save $150" (green text)
- "2 items selected" (small gray text)

---

## Floating Elements

**Chat Button** (Bottom right):
- Purple circular/pill button
- Chat bubble icon
- Text: "Ask Zoe"
- Fixed position, shadow effect

---

## Design System Details

**Color Palette**:
- Primary: Orange/Yellow (`#FFA500`, `#FFC107`)
- Secondary: Coral/Salmon (`#FF7043`, `#FF8A65`)
- Accent: Purple (`#7B1FA2`, `#9C27B0`) for bundle/chat
- Success: Green (`#4CAF50`) for stock/checkmarks
- Error/Discount: Pink/Red (`#E91E63`, `#F44336`)
- Backgrounds: Light gray (`#FAFAFA`), White (`#FFFFFF`), Cream (`#FFF8E1`)

**Typography**:
- Sans-serif font family (likely Inter, Roboto, or similar)
- Title: 28-32px, weight 700
- Price: 36px, weight 800
- Body: 14-16px, weight 400
- Small text: 12-13px

**Spacing**:
- Container max-width: ~1200-1400px, centered
- Column gaps: ~24-32px
- Card padding: ~20-24px
- Border radius: 8-12px for cards, 20-24px for pills/buttons
- Shadows: Subtle box-shadows on cards (`0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`)

**Interactive States**:
- Hover effects on buttons (slight darken/lift)
- Selected states with borders/highlights
- Focus rings for accessibility

This is a modern, conversion-optimized product page with clear visual hierarchy, trust signals, urgency elements (timer), and cross-sell opportunities (bundle).
